audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with their own prose: whys[0] says he pokes you down with no sustain trigger yet (charted Skill), whys[1] ends 'roughly even' (charted Heimerdinger), whys[4] calls level 6 'your hardest all-in and dive spike' and whys[5] says 'force every all-in here' (both charted against Gragas).
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Heimerdinger, Skill, Heimerdinger, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Heimerdinger — exactly what the whys describe.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 -> Heimerdinger, 1 -> Skill, 4 -> Gragas, 5 -> Gragas in both layers, with ratings and rewritten phases[].why. Proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns in the full layer; the grenade was 'his self-peel stun' with no timer, and Gragas's spikes were 'your committal tool' and 'your ultimate'.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank — the single most useful number in this lane, because it tells you exactly how long the dive window lasts. Micro-Rockets are 11/10/9/8/7, Body Slam 14s, Explosive Cask 100s.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood and tradeBad now carry 11s, 14s and 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer stated that the grenade only stuns on a direct hit — the surrounding splash merely slows. The pages just say 'dodge it'.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units'. Clipping the edge costs you a slow, not the stun, which changes whether you keep committing a dive after it lands.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d now state direct hit stuns, splash slows — sidestep the center.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad said a whiffed Body Slam is '13 seconds' and never named the punish.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1, and the punish is eating the grenade stun inside his turret field.
audit.corrected: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d rewritten with 14s and the turret-nest consequence.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Heimerdinger contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His turret and Micro-Rockets chip you before Happy Hour and Drunken Rage are online — last-hit at the edge of Barrel Roll.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade is down.
edits.after: Drunken Rage plus a Happy Hour heal buys a real sustain trade, but his turret still walls the wave — roughly even.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Body Slam–Flash into Explosive Cask knocks him off his turret nest and out of the zone — your hardest all-in and dive window. Bait the grenade first.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on CH-2 Grenade's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker: Body Slam into drink-auto into Barrel Roll bursts him before the grenade resets.

edits.before: Q-poke Heimerdinger on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll from max range, Drunken Rage before you step up, Body Slam only once the grenade is spent — 11s.

edits.before: Q-poke Heimerdinger on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll from max range, Drunken Rage before you step up, Body Slam only once the grenade is spent — 11s.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam into his grenade — a direct hit stuns you inside the turret nest and E is down 14s.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam into his grenade — a direct hit stuns you inside the turret nest and E is down 14s.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His self-peel stun, 11s flat — bait it, then commit before it returns.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A direct hit stuns; the splash only slows, so sidestep the center.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: matchup-defining — 11s flat; a direct hit stuns, the splash only slows. - Micro-Rockets: 11s at rank 1. - Body Slam: 14s. - Explosive Cask: 100s, kill windows only.

notes: No mirror existed; heimerdinger__gragas should restate inverted: Heimer ahead at 1 and 3, even at 2 and 4-5, Gragas ahead at 6 and first item, Heimer at 2+ items. Chart flips are one atomic group across both layers with ratings. The grenade's direct-hit-stuns / splash-slows split comes straight from Riot's E text and is now on the page. Both packet suspect names ('Body Slam-' and "Drunken Rage's") are false positives — correct names with a trailing hyphen and a possessive.
